summary: Keep GitHub plugin transition tests valid when the compatibility baseline already ships the plugin

replay.detail: Only compatibility test expectations change; production claim replay is unchanged.

schema.detail: No database schema, index, trigger or storage version changes.

rules.detail: No production admission, checkpoint rule or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Two fleet tests condition pre-plugin expectations on the baseline's advertised capability, retaining upgrade and replication coverage. Production contracts are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Test-only expectation changes require no service restart or migration.

manual.detail: No manual upgrade steps are required.

recovery.detail: No production state or recovery path changes.
